node.statement: Commutativity forcing with constants bound locally: let K>=1 and 0<=eta<=(24K)^{-1}. If B satisfies node 1.4, then B is commutative. Otherwise node 1.5 supplies contractions x,y with commutator norm 2, whereas node 1.4 gives 2<=10K*eta<=10/24=5/12<2, a contradiction.
